jobs.title: Program Manager - VA OCDAO Data and Analytics (Remote)
jobs.description:
Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is recruiting a **Program Manager** for our proposed support to the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Information and Technology (OIT), Office of the Chief Data and Analytics Officer (OCDAO). **This position is contingent upon contract award.** Remote work from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to Washington, DC.

**ABOUT THE WORK**

The Program Manager is the single point of accountability to OCDAO for the consolidated data and analytics effort: integrating business analytics, data governance, enterprise data architecture and mission success support across a team of about 40 people plus surge.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Lead the C0 Enterprise Data and Analytics Integrator work stream and integrate work streams C1 through C4
* Set and report the outcome-metric baseline (up to 12 months) and the Reduce, Reuse, Alignment and Efficiency principles
* Manage cost, schedule, scope, quality and staffing; manage teaming partners and surge tier orders
* Serve as the primary contact for the Contracting Officer's Representative and OCDAO leadership

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* U.S. citizenship required
* Able to obtain and keep a VA Tier 1 / Low Risk background investigation and complete VA privacy and security training
* Bachelor's degree
* 15+ years of program or project management, including management of IT or data programs

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* VA OIT program management at comparable scale (about 40 FTEs plus surge)
* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Data and analytics, data governance or enterprise architecture programs

**SCHEDULE AND LOCATION**

Full-time. Remote within the United States; Eastern business hours; occasional travel to Washington, DC. Anticipated start February 2027.

**WHY TRIUMPH**

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia, operating under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system. We price our work based on local market wages, ensuring we fairly compensate our team rather than paying the bare minimum.

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire strictly on the basis of qualifications and merit, providing equal consideration to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Sponsorships & Experiential
jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

More than a traditional project manager, the Project Manager, Sponsorship & Experiential will own the execution of a high-priority initiative while also coordinating a variety of projects across the broader team as it matures into an enterprise-wide Center of Excellence. Work assignments will involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The ideal candidate is a natural orchestrator who loves bringing order to complexity. They can zoom out to understand strategic priorities, then zoom in to manage details that drive execution. They are comfortable leading without formal authority, building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and keeping multiple moving pieces on track simultaneously. They thrive at creating clarity, accountability, and momentum that help teams perform at their best.

**Job Description**:

Humana is a $100+ billion, Fortune 50, healthcare leader dedicated to improving the health and well-being of the people we serve. To help deliver on this mission, we are seeking a highly organized, strategic, and proactive Project Manager to lead the execution of an enterprise-wide priority initiative while serving as the operational hub for a growing Sponsorship & Experiential Center of Excellence (COE). This role acts as both the "quarterback" for key projects and the "air traffic controller" for the broader team, ensuring priorities, resources, timelines, and stakeholder communications remain aligned.

The ideal candidate thrives in complex, cross-functional environments, brings rigor to project planning and governance, and can seamlessly move between strategic planning and day-to-day execution. Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills, the ability to influence without authority, and a talent for bringing structure and clarity to ambiguity.

This role will liaise with internal departments and external partners to ensure full communication and success of project plans; constantly monitor performance of team initiatives to ensure they meet organization objectives; ensure effective administration of projects and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. This role will make decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction. This role will exercise considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. This is an opportunity to be the originator of a newly developed role, molding and shaping it into its highest potential. Success requires a proactive approach to problem-solving and a growth mindset focused on continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure objectives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business goals.
* Facilitate project meetings, decision-making forums, and executive updates.
* Identify and proactively mitigate project risks, issues, and roadblocks.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders and ensure commitments are met.

* Serve as the central coordinator for the COE's initiatives, priorities, and workflow.
* Maintain visibility into all active projects, requests, and resource allocations across the team.
* Manage governance processes, project intake procedures, and prioritization frameworks.
* Monitor team capacity and identify potential conflicts, overlaps, or resource constraints.
* Create and maintain reporting dashboards, status updates, and leadership communications.
* Ensure alignment of workstreams with organizational priorities and strategic objectives.

* Help build the foundational operating model for a best-in-class Center of Excellence.
* Develop standardized tools, templates, project management practices, and ways of working.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Champion project management discipline and foster a culture of accountability and execution excellence.
* Support strategic planning and roadmap development for the COE.

* Build strong partnerships across business functions, leadership teams, and external partners.
* Translate complex information into clear, concise communications tailored to various audiences.
* Escalate key decisions, risks, and dependencies appropriately.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on project execution and operational effectiveness.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree (Business, Marketing, Communications, Operations, or related field preferred)
* 5+ years of project, program, or operational management experience.
* Proven track record managing multiple complex, cross-functional projects simultaneously.
* Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.
* Exceptional communication and presentation abilities.
* Experience developing executive-ready reporting and status communications.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Master's Degree
* PMP, Agile, Scrum, or similar project management certification.
* Prior health insurance industry experience
* Experience supporting a Center of Excellence, shared services organization, or matrixed team.
* Experience managing complex projects in marketing, brand management or sponsorships.
* Change management experience.

**Additional Information**

  

* This position will operate under Eastern Standard (EST) or Central Standard (CST) hours.
* This position may require travel 1-2 times a year.

  
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home

jobs.title: CARE Customer Experience Program Manager- Remote
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

A Program Manager 2 is a key member of the CARE Customer Experience (CCX) Enablement + Transformation team responsible for leading the change-management and deployment strategies that bring the CARE Service Model to life. The role ensures that leaders, teams, and business partners are prepared to adopt new capabilities, processes, technologies, and ways of working.

The Program Manager 2 builds scalable change-management practices, readiness frameworks, and deployment approaches that support CARE transformation initiatives. Working across CARE Operations, Customer Experience, Product, Technology, Analytics, Training, Communications, and enterprise partners, the role drives readiness, adoption, and sustainment to achieve lasting business and customer outcomes. This position serves as CARE's change-management and deployment lead, helping translate strategic priorities into successful organizational adoption and measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and evolve CARE's change-management capability, including frameworks, standards, tools, templates, governance, deployment playbooks, and best practices.
* Design deployment strategies for the CARE Service Model and major transformation initiatives, translating strategic priorities into actionable implementation, readiness, adoption, and sustainment plans.
* Partner with business leaders to assess organizational impacts, identify readiness needs, and develop deployment approaches that support successful adoption.
* Establish deployment governance, readiness reviews, decision points, and accountability structures that improve execution consistency across CARE.
* Maintain a portfolio view of organizational change across CARE, including dependencies, audience impacts, deployment timing, change saturation, and risk.
* Lead change-impact assessments and readiness planning across people, process, technology, knowledge, and ways of working.
* Develop and execute communication, engagement, learning, sponsor, and leadership enablement strategies that prepare teams for change and reinforce adoption.
* Define and measure readiness, adoption, deployment effectiveness, and business outcomes, using insights to improve future deployments.
* Monitor deployment health and lead stabilization and sustainment activities to ensure changes are embedded into day-to-day operations.
* Coach leaders, program teams, and business partners on change-management practices and help build organizational change capability across CARE.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, governance forums, and decision discussions that remove barriers and maintain forward progress.
* Produce executive-ready reporting, recommendations, and decision support materials that provide visibility into change impacts, readiness, risks, progress, and business outcomes.
* Influence leaders, initiative owners, and enterprise partners without direct authority to drive alignment and shared accountability for successful adoption.

**Success Measures**

  

* CARE Service Model initiatives deliver intended customer, employee, operational, and business outcomes while maintaining operational stability.
* Readiness and adoption data are actively used to improve deployment outcomes and decision-making.
* CARE establishes a scalable and repeatable change-management and deployment capability that is consistently used across transformation initiatives.
* Leaders and teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and what is expected of them.
* New capabilities, processes, technologies, and ways of working are successfully adopted and sustained.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 3-5+ years of program management, organizational change management, customer experience, or equivalent experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience preferred; relevant organizational change management or program management certification is a plus.
* AI-fluency with the ability to assess organizational impacts and develop readiness, adoption, and change-management strategies that support successful implementation.
* Proven project management and oversight capabilities
* Demonstrated problem solving, negotiation and facilitation skills
* Ability to work effectively in a fast moving, multi-project team environment
* Proficient in Microsoft applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Visio, SharePoint)
* Superior verbal and precise written communication skills

Rackner is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager to lead day-to-day service operations supporting a complex federal health IT mission. This role brings together clinical, training, field, and technical teams to keep services coordinated, resources available, and operational commitments on track.

You'll work closely with program leadership to manage competing priorities, coordinate workforce capacity, and address operational challenges across multiple service-delivery functions. This opportunity offers meaningful leadership responsibility in a DoD environment, where sound operational decisions help support military health services and mission readiness.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead day-to-day service operations across multiple teams supporting a complex federal health IT mission.
* Coordinate operational schedules and priorities across training, field activities, military exercises, and ongoing service delivery.
* Manage workforce capacity and resource coordination to support operational readiness and service continuity.
* Identify and address scheduling conflicts, staffing challenges, and competing operational priorities.
* Coordinate supplemental staffing and surge support in response to changing mission needs, ensuring activities remain within authorized work requirements.
* Lead weekly operational and monthly service reviews, communicating progress, risks, and priorities to program leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in service management or operations leadership supporting Department of Defense (DoD) programs.

* ITIL 4 Managing Professional certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

We value collaboration, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement. Our environment encourages professional growth and provides opportunities to strengthen service delivery and contribute to meaningful mission outcomes.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Professional Services Program Manager at GitLab, you will lead the delivery of complex, multi-workstream services engagements for some of our largest and most strategic customers. You will help customers turn transformation goals into clear execution plans by bringing structure, visibility, and accountability across interconnected projects. Working closely with customer stakeholders and GitLab team members, you will guide programs from planning through delivery while building trusted relationships across executive, technical, and delivery teams. In this role, you will define and apply a strong delivery methodology grounded in agile and project management best practices, communicate that approach clearly, and keep teams aligned on milestones, dependencies, and outcomes. This is a strong opportunity to shape how customers adopt GitLab at scale and help them realize meaningful business value through effective program leadership.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including executive leaders, program and project managers, engineering, development, and security teams

* Create and continuously communicate program roadmaps, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across connected projects
* Manage stakeholder expectations and secure approval on major milestones, decisions, and delivery plans
* Define program strategy, including business justification, expected benefits, in-scope and out-of-scope work, timelines, schedules, resources, stakeholders, and success criteria
* Establish core program structures such as RACI charts, work breakdown structures, communication plans, and escalation paths
* Work closely with Engagement Managers and Regional Delivery Managers to support program scoping, review delivery assumptions, and help improve project management processes through quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs)

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Experience leading **complex programs** with multiple interdependent projects, stakeholders, and timelines

* Ability to organize, monitor, and manage long-term project budgets, schedules, risks, and dependencies
* Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with customers and partner effectively with Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery teams
* Working knowledge of agile and other project management approaches, with the judgment to apply the right structure to different customer needs
* Ability to develop long-term plans that support customer adoption, transformation, and successful delivery outcomes
* Comfort leading program-level meetings and driving progress across multiple workstreams
* Willingness to complete **GitLab Project Management certification** within 2 months of starting in the role

**About the team**
------------------

On our Professional Services team, we help customers adopt GitLab effectively by turning strategy into structured delivery. As Program Managers on our team, we bring clarity to large, complex engagements by coordinating people, plans, and processes across multiple workstreams. We work closely with customers, Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery leaders to create practical plans, manage risk, and keep programs moving toward agreed outcomes. Because we operate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, we value clear communication, strong documentation, and ownership. This role is well suited for you if you enjoy building order in complex environments, guiding stakeholders through change, and helping customers make progress on meaningful transformation efforts.

jobs.title: Project Manager, IOT Solutions
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized and technically proficient Project Manager within our R&D team that will act as the primary customer contact throughout the project lifecycle, manage scope, schedules, risks, financial milestones and expectations. The Project Manager will lead the planning and execution of IoT hardware projects, solutions and fleet management products from concept to mass production and release.

Reporting to the Director of Program and Project Management, this role requires deep understanding of hardware product development, embedded firmware integration and New Product Introduction (NPI) processes and expertise in project coordination, stakeholder management and agile/hybrid methodologies. You will collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, supply chain, and external vendors to ensure successful delivery of high-quality products on time and within budget. With opportunities for professional growth, this position plays a pivotal role in driving innovation, optimizing workflows, and delivering cutting- edge solutions to clients across various industries.

  

**Objectives & Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for Telit Cinterion customers throughout the project lifecycle, maintaining clear communication and alignment on objectives, deliverables, and expectations.
* Lead end-to-end project management of hardware and embedded firmware programs from concept through mass production ramp and release for IoT Solutions initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and timelines.
* Track the execution of NPI processes including design validation, EVT/DVT/PVT builds and transition to mass production as well as financial milestones for revenue recognition and invoicing.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including hardware, firmware, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality assurance to streamline development and deployment processes
* Develop and maintain project budgets and timelines, tracking milestones and mitigating risks proactively.
* Manage stakeholder communications, providing clear updates and ensuring alignment with client expectations and internal objectives.
* Partner with Professional Services, Sales, and customers to gather requirements, define project scope, estimate delivery needs, and develop customer-facing Statements of Work (SOWs).
* Resolve delivery barriers through proactive issue management, cross-functional collaboration, mediation, and escalation when appropriate.
* Improve project delivery practices, tools, and processes to increase consistency, efficiency, visibility, and customer satisfaction.
* Support customer engagements through occasional travel and continuously expand technical and business knowledge in a fast-paced environment.
  

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* 5–7 years of hands-on project management experience in hardware product development and embedded systems.

jobs.title: SharePoint Project Manager
jobs.description:
RedCloud seeks a **SharePoint Project Manager** to support immediate client operations.  
  
**Location:** United States **(**Remote), PST working hours.  
  
**Overview:**  
We are looking for a hands-on **SharePoint Project Manager** to own the rebuild of a client’s internal SharePoint site from beginning to end. This person will take the project from the Business Requirements Brief through discovery, design, build, testing and launch, and will do the redesign and build work directly rather than handing it off. Working closely with business owners and stakeholders, they will deliver a site that matches the look, structure and functionality the business needs, on schedule and ready to hand over to site owners.  
  
**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Review the Business Requirements Brief and formulate outstanding questions and inputs from business owners and internal stakeholders.
* Schedule and lead the project kick-off with stakeholders; present the project plan, timeline, design approach and outstanding questions.
* Lead discovery: audit the current site (content inventory, page and library usage, permissions, outdated or broken content) and capture stakeholders' desired look, functionality and user needs.
* Translate requirements into a site architecture (site and hub structure, navigation, page hierarchy, metadata and content types) and wireframes or mockups for stakeholder review.
* Vet the proposed architecture and design and solicit feedback, inputs and approval from the SMEs and business owners named in the Business Requirements Brief.
* Build the site hands-on in SharePoint Online: configure pages, web parts, navigation, lists and libraries, metadata, search and branding/theming in line with client brand and accessibility standards.
* Set up the permissions model and site governance with site owners, including ownership, content lifecycle and access requests.
* Plan and execute content migration with content owners: decide what to keep, rewrite, archive or retire; move content; and fix links.
* Manage the project timeline, inputs, reviews and approvals, and secure the collaboration of stakeholders and content owners to keep deliverables on pace, escalating to the FTE team when blockers need to be removed or expectations reset.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing; track, prioritize and resolve feedback and defects; and secure stakeholder sign-off for go-live.
* Manage launch: go-live cutover, redirects from the legacy site, and launch communications to site users.
* Deliver handoff: site owner training, governance and content maintenance documentation, and a defined post-launch support period.
* Run regular status meetings with stakeholders and report progress, risks, decisions and next steps.

**Required knowledge, skills, and abilities:**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building and launching SharePoint Online (modern) sites or intranets.
* Excellent client voice and the ability to lead meetings of multiple stakeholders across agendas.
* Demonstrated track record of owning a site build or redesign end to end, from requirements through go-live; examples or portfolio available on request.
* Proficiency with modern SharePoint: communication and hub sites, pages and web parts, navigation, lists and libraries, metadata, and permissions.
* Experience with information architecture and content migration.
* Strong project management skills: building and managing timelines, running stakeholder reviews and securing approvals.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive and Office).

**Proffered knowledge, skills, and abilities:**

* Experience with Power Automate, Power Apps or Viva Connections.
* SharePoint customization experience, such as site templates, custom themes and JSON column or view formatting.
* UX or visual design skills, including wireframing tools such as Figma.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG).
* Experience with change management and user adoption for intranet launches.

Benefits and bonus information can be found at https://www.redcloudconsulting.com/careers

Anchored in a foundation of *integrity-based consulting*, RedCloud brings together senior-level experts who work side by side with client teams to design and implement durable, high-impact solutions. Our approach emphasizes trust, accountability, and long-term value—balancing stability, growth, and innovation to help organizations operate securely and confidently in an increasingly complex global environment.

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

  

This position is responsible for the end-to-end Request for Proposal (RFP) process, including data collection, pricing strategy, profit model construction, and proposal development. The Business Analyst gathers and analyzes customer, supplier, market, and financial data to identify trends, evaluate opportunities, develop recommendations, and support informed business decisions.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

RFP Analysis and Management

* Manage the end-to-end RFP process from initial opportunity assessment through final proposal submission.
* Review RFP requirements, timelines, customer objectives, evaluation criteria, and submission instructions.
* Coordinate with sales, finance, operations, supplier partners, legal, and other internal stakeholders to gather required information and complete proposal deliverables.
* Develop pricing strategies using customer, supplier, market, competitive, and historical performance data.
* Construct detailed profit models to evaluate projected sales, gross profit, rebates, and other financial considerations.
* Analyze customer purchasing activity to identify the optimal product mix and market basket.
* Evaluate customer and supplier performance and identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance patterns.
* Develop reports and analyze sales, gross profit dollars, return on investment, customer spend, rebate eligibility, and other measures of business performance.
* Write, edit, and assemble clear and accurate proposal responses that address customer requirements and communicate the organization’s value proposition.
* Facilitate internal reviews and approvals to ensure pricing, financial assumptions, contractual terms, and proposal content are accurate and aligned with business objectives.
* Perform recurring analyses and make recommendations on a monthly, quarterly, or other scheduled basis, as well as ad hoc analyses in response to business needs.

Price Analysis and Evaluation

* Compile the information necessary to evaluate and report on the performance of customers, suppliers, business segments, or the division.
* Extract, organize, and validate data from the Data Warehouse, operating systems, external market resources, and other available sources.
* Gather customer purchasing, pricing, contract, rebate, supplier-cost, and market information to support business and pricing analyses.
* Works with supplier partners to ensure we are utilizing the best contract costs available for the customer.

Pricing Implementation

* Create, maintain and update price plans.
* Audit plans to ensure customer receives the correct price point.

* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.

Typically 5 to 7 or more years of increasing responsibility in terms of any applicable professional experience.

Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline. Master's degree or global equivalent a plus. May hold one or more industry certifications; professional certification may be required to advance.

Travel typically less than 10%. Office environment. No special physical demands required.

jobs.title: IT Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh McLennan Agency

**Description:**
----------------

**Our not-so-secret sauce.**

  

Award-winning, inclusive, Top Workplace culture doesn’t happen overnight. It’s a result of hard work by extraordinary people. The industry’s brightest talent drive our efforts to deliver purposeful work and meaningful impact every day. Learn more about what makes us different and how you can make your mark as a Salesforce Developer at Marsh Agency.

  

Marsh Agency helps people and organizations manage risk and prepare for the future through insurance, benefits, retirement, and wealth management strategies. We believe in hands-on proactive service, data-driven insights, and understanding how global events can impact local decisions. As a trusted partner, we show our clients what’s possible and guide them during every step of their journey.

  

**A day in the life**

  

As an IT Operations Analyst on the IT Strategy & Operations team, you will serve as a central hub for enabling strong operational and financial management across the IT organization. You will own core IT financial planning activities (forecasting, budgeting, and spend management), with a particular focus on outside services and third-party spend. This role will also manage day-to-day vendor relationships and contract administration activities, ensuring work is delivered as expected and vendors and contractors are onboarded and offboarded smoothly. The ideal candidate can operate independently, bring structure to ambiguity, and partner effectively with IT leaders, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Accounts Payable, and vendors.

  
  

**Our future colleague.**

We’d love to meet you if your professional track record includes these skills:

  
  

**IT financial planning, forecasting & budget management (outside services focus)**

* Own the forecasting and budget process for the IT organization, with emphasis on outside services / third-party spend.

* Maintain run-rate views and forecast models; identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities and provide clear variance commentary versus prior forecasts and budgets.

* Partner with IT leaders and cost owners to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and drive timely submissions for monthly/quarterly cycles.

* Support month-end activities as needed (e.g., accrual tracking, invoice timing, and forecast updates) in coordination with Finance and Accounts Payable.

* Maintain financial trackers and data integrity across sources (e.g., invoices, POs, contracts, budget trackers); reconcile discrepancies and document assumptions.

* Prepare executive-ready summaries, dashboards, and talking points that translate financial details into decisions and actions for IT leadership.

Identify and implement process improvements to streamline budgeting/forecasting and improve transparency of third-party spend.  

  

**Vendor management, contracting support & performance monitoring**

* Manage day-to-day vendor relationship and contract administration activities for IT outside services providers.

* Support new sourcing events (RFIs/RFPs/RFQs) by coordinating requirements, gathering documentation, organizing responses, and supporting evaluation and selection.

* Monitor active vendor engagements to evaluate delivery quality and facilitate renewals

Support basic spend analysis and vendor reporting to improve cost visibility and identify optimization opportunities.  

  

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* 3–5+ years of experience in technology finance, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), IT financial operations, vendor management, procurement/contract administration, or a comparable cross-functional role.

* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining budgets/forecasts, performing variance analysis, and translating results into clear written commentary and leadership-ready insights.

* Experience managing third-party / outside services spend in an IT organization (professional services, managed services, SaaS/software, cloud, or related technology categories).

* Hands-on Excel skills (e.g., pivots, lookups, data validation, reconciliation) and comfort working with imperfect data from multiple sources.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to independently prioritize work and meet recurring deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to coordinate across IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and vendor partners.

* Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential financial, vendor, and personnel information.
  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with forecasting and budgeting tools such as Oracle, IBM Apptio, etc.

* Experience supporting RFx processes, contract renewals, and vendor performance reporting.

* Experience building simple dashboards or reporting (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) to improve visibility of spend and vendor performance.

Experience in financial services, insurance, or professional services environments.  

  

We know there are excellent candidates who might not check all of these boxes. Don’t be shy. If you’re close, we’d be very interested in meeting you.

  
  

**Valuable benefits.**

We value and respect the impact our colleagues make every day both inside and outside of work. Our culture promotes colleague well-being through robust benefits programs and resources, professional and personal development opportunities, and fulfillment through meaningful work.

Some benefits included in this role are:

* Generous time off, including personal and volunteering
* Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities
* Hybrid OR Remote work
* Charitable contribution match programs
Stock purchase opportunities  

  

To learn more about a career at Marsh Agency, check us out our website or flip through our recruiting brochure.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The Discovery team sits at the intersection of product analytics and operations within Uber Eats, owning one of the highest-leverage surfaces on the platform, how millions of eaters discover restaurants, grocery, and retail stores every day. This is not a traditional operations role. You will spend the majority of your time deep in data, writing complex SQL, building analytical frameworks, and running experiments that directly shape search ranking and cross-LOB placement across Uber Eats.  
  
You will be the analytical backbone for Search, partnering hands-on with Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and peer Ops teams to translate massive datasets into actionable insights that influence ranking algorithms, drive experimentation roadmaps, and optimize how traffic is allocated across restaurants, grocery, and retail. If you thrive on navigating ambiguity with data rather than playbooks, and want to see your analysis directly move product decisions at scale, this is the role.  
  
**What You'll Do**  

* Own search analytics end-to-end: Write complex SQL queries against large-scale datasets to analyze search ranking performance, cross-LOB store and item placement, and conversion patterns across categories
* Build analytical products: Create and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and monitoring tools that give Product, Ops, and Leadership real-time visibility into search health, ranking quality, and surface-level KPIs (conversion, GMV, engagement)
* Translate data into product influence: Synthesize operational and behavioral insights into clear recommendations that shape the search product roadmap, identifying ranking biases, surfacing gaps in cross-LOB allocation, and quantifying the impact of proposed changes
* Collaborate cross-functionally: Work across Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and regional Ops teams to ensure search strategy is grounded in data and aligned across stakeholders. Serve as the connective tissue between operational reality and product development
* Manage programs and projects: Independently drive multiple workstreams from competitive search intelligence to new surface launches tracking details, managing timelines, and delivering in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift
* Scale shared surface governance: Contribute to Share of Voice frameworks and traffic allocation governance across Restaurants, Grocery, and Retail on shared discovery surfaces

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics) or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or analytically-heavy operations roles
* Advanced SQL proficiency, write complex, production-quality queries against large-scale data warehouses (Hive/Presto or equivalent)
* Hands-on experience with Python or R for data manipulation, analysis, and automation
* Experience building dashboards and automated reporting that serve cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated track record of using data to influence product or business decisions in a cross-functional environment

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of professional work experience in a related field, such as consulting, investment banking, strategy, operations, or analytics
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets or SQL proficiency
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
* Experience problem-solving and proposing unique solutions to complex issues
* Strong experience building and executing complex processes
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting data & insights to a sophisticated audience
* Experience with quantitative data analysis to provide deep measurable insights
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills - building deep, trust-based relationships with teams and cross-functional partners
* Strong business judgment and critical thinking skills with the ability to use data to develop strategies and make decisions quickly

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year - USD $145,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year - USD $145,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

jobs.description:
About ECI
  
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
  
At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by our commitment to empowering our employees around the world.
  
  
Program Manager – AI Adoption Service
  
Job Description
  
Role Summary
  
The Program Manager (AI Adoption Service) is a client-facing delivery lead responsible for translating strategy into execution across AI adoption engagements. This role functions as a hybrid Program Manager / Project Manager, combining cross-workstream coordination and stakeholder alignment with hands-on ownership of day-to-day project execution. The individual in this role serves as the operational backbone of the engagement—owning scope, schedule, RAID, stakeholder communications, decision tracking, and delivery coordination across multiple workstreams—while ensuring readiness, enablement, governance, and adoption activities remain aligned to client objectives, contractual deliverables, and measurable business outcomes.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Project planning & controls: Build, maintain, and actively manage the integrated project plan across workstreams, milestones, dependencies, owners, and critical path items; proactively address slippage, sequencing issues, and resource conflicts to keep delivery on track.
* Day-to-day project ownership: Act as the de facto project manager for the team by driving weekly priorities, coordinating deliverables, following up on open actions, and ensuring work moves forward between formal status meetings.
* Client leadership & facilitation: Serve as the day-to-day client lead for execution; facilitate working sessions, steering meetings, and status reviews; drive alignment across IT, security, compliance, business stakeholders, and executive sponsors.
* Cross-functional delivery orchestration: Coordinate delivery across internal SMEs and client resources spanning adoption/change management, technical architecture, security/compliance, data readiness, Copilot Studio/agents, and end-user enablement.
* Deliverables management: Own the delivery calendar for workshops, training sessions, communications, assessments, and reporting deliverables; ensure each output has clear ownership, review cycles, due dates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Status reporting & executive communication: Produce weekly status updates and executive-ready readouts that summarize progress, milestone health, key accomplishments, risks/issues, upcoming decisions, and remediation plans.
* RAID & change control: Maintain RAID logs, action and decision registers, and escalation paths; manage change requests and scope adjustments in alignment with the SOW, timeline, dependencies, and commercial impact.
* Team coordination & accountability: Keep internal and client team members aligned on priorities, decisions, deadlines, and next steps; ensure meetings end with clear owners and timelines, and follow through to closure.
* Adoption measurement: Partner with internal and client stakeholders to define success measures, establish baselines, and track KPIs such as usage, training participation, scenario adoption, stakeholder satisfaction, and business value indicators.
* Readiness & remediation tracking: Monitor progress against readiness findings and remediation actions tied to governance, security, technical prerequisites, and organizational change activities so adoption blockers are surfaced and resolved early.
* Continuous improvement: Capture lessons learned, improve templates and playbooks, and help standardize repeatable delivery methods that support a scalable AI adoption services model.
* Engagement growth support: Identify renewal, expansion, and adjacent-service opportunities; coordinate the operational inputs required for proposals, change orders, and updated SOWs.

Required Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of experience as a client-facing Project Manager, Program Manager, or delivery lead managing technology initiatives in consulting, professional services, or managed services environments.
* Demonstrated success owning day-to-day project execution, including scope, schedule, communications, RAID, dependency management, deliverables tracking, and—where applicable—budget oversight against SOW-defined commitments.
* Strong experience acting as the operational point person across internal teams and client stakeholders, with the ability to drive alignment, decisions, follow-through, and accountability in complex environments.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 platforms including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange, with familiarity in Microsoft 365 Copilot concepts, rollout considerations, and adoption challenges.
* Comfort partnering with security, compliance, governance, and technical stakeholders while managing delivery risk in regulated or risk-sensitive environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convert detailed project status into clear executive summaries, steering updates, client-facing communications, and team action plans.
* Proficiency with PM tooling such as Microsoft Project, Planner, Teams, Excel, and related collaboration/reporting tools, along with disciplined project hygiene across meeting notes, action logs, decision logs, and status reporting.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, adapt to evolving client priorities, and maintain delivery momentum while balancing structure with flexibility.

Preferred Qualifications

**Senior Business Analyst for the Division of Budget and Program Operations (City HAP Program)**
================================================================================================

* HOUSING PRESERVATION & DVLPMNT

NYC-ALL BOROS

PROGRAM OPERATIONS

Salary range: $62,868.00 – $90,000.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

About The Agency:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  
  
Your Team:
  
  
The Office of Housing Access and Stability (“HAS”) consists of the divisions of Housing Opportunity, Tenant and Owner Resources, Housing Stability, Budget and Program Operations, and Program Policy and Innovation. The mission of the office is to ensure fair, efficient, and transparent access to affordable housing. The Office provides subsidies, placement services, and tools that connect New Yorkers to affordable housing and ensures vulnerable households in subsidized housing have the support they need to be safely housed. Housing Access is committed to expanding housing choices, affirmatively furthering fair housing, and stabilizing the financial health of buildings.
  
  
The Division of Budget and Program Operations (BPO) within the Office of Housing Access and Stability provides support services to the Division of Housing Opportunity, Division of Tenant and Owner Resources, the Division of Housing Stability, and the Division of Policy and Program Innovation. BPO assists with monitoring and supporting program budgeting and planning, including both staffing and procurement support. The Division also manages the Housing Quality Enforcement and related inspection functions for the Office. In addition, the BPO team coordinates technology initiatives and analytics across the Office in coordination with key technology stakeholders across the agency, providing support on key systems to internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Your Impact:
  
  
The City Housing Assistance Program (CHAP) is a city funded rental assistance program administered by the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD). The program provides rental assistance to low-income households with incomes at or below 50% of Area Median Income (AMI) who are at risk of homelessness, including eligible rent-stabilized households facing eviction for nonpayment of rent and certain households residing in shelter who do not qualify for existing rental assistance programs. CityHAP helps eligible households maintain stable, permanent housing by subsidizing their rent, with the household generally contributing 30% of its adjusted monthly income toward rent. The program provides targeted assistance to New Yorkers facing housing instability while helping preserve rent-stabilized housing and prevent homelessness.
  
  
Your Role:
  
  
The Division of Tenant and Owner Resources is in the process of implementing a series of large transformative technology projects that affect all users in the division. Under the direction of the Director for Program Strategy, you will be assisting in managing the implementation of HPD’s 5 Year Technology Plan for the Office of Housing Access and Stability and other technological initiatives.
  
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
  
o Assist with the management and execution of DTR’s 5 Year Technology plan. Participate in meetings with HAS, vendors and HPD Tech teams to assess operational issues, suggest technology solutions, catalog existing technology and technology needs, and strategize the delivery and timing of technology solutions.
  
o Assist in managing and coordinating multiple technology projects. Participate in working with HAS staff, stakeholders and leadership, collecting requirements, and assisting with prioritization. Maintain a working knowledge of technologies, and projects in flight; their level of effort; and release schedules.
  
o Work closely with business analysts within the PSA team and HAS staff to learn and ensure technology is deployed is operationalized effectively. Where appropriate assist developing the As-Is and To-Be workflows, training aids and manuals, and perform training. Coordinate with appropriate teams for post go-live support.
  
o Establish, maintain, track, and monitor project plans and assignments to ensure that project timelines are followed from conception to delivery.
  
o Assist in creating presentations and data analysis for team meetings as needed.
  
o Work on other projects and initiatives, at the discretion of the Director, that further strengthen and enhance the goals and mission of the Office.
  
o Develop an in-depth knowledge of HAS business operations and work with stakeholders to design new processes that achieve strategic goals.
  
o Coordinate with other business analysts and project managers to ensure integration of technical solutions.
  
  
Preferred skills:
  
  
o The candidate must have at least 4 years of experience in Business Analysis, Project Management and Managing deadlines and milestones. Assisting in technology strategy development and implementation. Coordinating and supporting IT business processes. You will be expected to develop and maintain momentum on high priority projects.

jobs.description:
***Title:***  
Program Manager
  
  
***Location:***  
Princeton, NJ - 2 days per week in office required. Applicants not clearly local to Princeton will not be considered.  
  
***Reports To:***  
Director, Program Management
  
  
***Salary Range:***  
$80,000 – $120,000. Exact compensation will vary based on experience  
  
***Other:***  
Vaccination against COVID-19 is a prerequisite for employment at CHDI Management  
  
***About CHDI Foundation, Inc.***  
CHDI Foundation, Inc. is a privately funded nonprofit biomedical research organization exclusively dedicated to collaboratively developing therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease (HD). Our scientists work closely with a network of more than 700 researchers in academic and industrial laboratories around the world in the pursuit of these novel therapies, providing strategic scientific direction to ensure that our common goals remain in focus. This helps bridge the translational gap that often exists between academic and industrial research pursuits and that adds costly delays to therapy development. In its role as a collaborative enabler, CHDI seeks to bring the right partners together to identify and address critical scientific issues and move drug candidates to clinical evaluation as rapidly as possible. Our activities extend from exploratory biology to the identification and validation of therapeutic targets, and from drug discovery and development to clinical studies and trials. More information about CHDI can be found at www.chdifoundation.org.  
  
***Job Description:***  
We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Program Manager to join the preclinical Program Management Office supporting various preclinical teams. The candidate should have strong experience in the coordination and management of translational and preclinical studies. In addition, the candidate should be very detail-oriented and have significant experience working with Ph.D. level scientists. The position offers significant growth opportunities, exposure to a new model of non-profit orphan disease drug discovery, and an entrepreneurial work environment with high impact.
  
  
***Job Responsibilities:***

* Work with CHDI Science Directors to understand project goals and deliverables in order to enable the execution of legal contracts with collaborators, including fee-for-service companies, academic institutions, pharmaceutical companies and biotechnology companies.
* Work with CHDI’s finance and legal officers to execute contracts in compliance with Foundation policies.
* Work with scientists and the financial officer to evaluate and optimize proposed budgets for new projects.
* Use existing tracking tools to monitor the progress of executed contracts in accordance with the terms specified in each contract.
* Identify and communicate potential issues and delays to scientists, the legal department and the financial officer in a timely manner and propose solutions to remedy the issues in an expedited fashion.
* Liaise with collaborative counterparts to ensure: a) that studies are conducted in accordance with corresponding contracts; and b) that deliverables are delivered on time and per allocated funds to each such study.
* Work with materials/data repository managers to ensure: a) that materials/data are available and can be provided for a given study prior to the execution of contracts; and b) that materials/data generated by collaborators are properly registered in CHDI’s databases, consequently tracked and deposited.
* Participate and host internal and external meetings as needed, prepare meeting minutes, follow up on action items and act in an ‘advisory’ role on matters related to operations, finances and legal issues.
* Ensure all post-execution contract management requirements are performed including invoicing, audit reports, material shipments, amendments, and contract close-outs.
* Review periodic invoices, ensuring they align with financial terms of corresponding contracts and CHDI policy, flag discrepancies and resolve issues with collaborators and/or the CHDI financial officer in an expedited fashion to meet the monthly timeline.
* Review academic financial audit reports and reconcile any discrepancies. Work with principal investigators and grant analysts at academic institutions to understand and resolve budgetary discrepancies.
* File scientific reports and project management documents in CHDI’s document management system and distribute internally to relevant individuals.
* Prepare and summarize contract budgetary information to support annual fiscal year forecasting.
* As required, work with scientific team leads to track team Goals, Strategies, and Objectives in existing tracking tools, ensuring updates to project status and resources.
* Participate in monthly Program Managers’ team meetings and host selected meetings in accordance with the pre-established schedule.
* Propose tools and strategies to streamline and optimize tracking of studies and expenditures whenever possible.

* Bachelors or Masters Degree in life sciences or chemical sciences.

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
* Experience in licensing, technology transfer and alliance management in industry or academia a plus.
* Self-motivator and resourceful.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Superior written and oral communication skills.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager
jobs.description:
Public Consulting Group LLC (PCG) is a leading public sector solutions implementation and operations improvement firm that partners with health, education, and human services agencies to improve lives. Founded in 1986, PCG employs approximately 2,000 professionals throughout the U.S.—all committed to delivering solutions that change lives for the better. The firm is a member of a family of companies with experience in all 50 states, and clients in three Canadian provinces and Europe. PCG offers clients a multidisciplinary approach to meet challenges, pursue opportunities, and serve constituents across the public sector. To learn more, visit www.publicconsultinggroup.com .

Collaborating with our Technology Consulting team, you will help organizations streamline operations and achieve strategic goals to serve the public better. We provide the full spectrum of technology consulting services to help state and local agencies meet operational and program needs that enhance the lives of their user base.

Services:

* Strategy, Architecture, Planning, and Procurement
* Business Enablement
* Business Solutions
* Project Assurance

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Evaluates programs and makes recommendations for improvements.
* Assesses best practices and provides technical assistance to clients.

* Serves as Lead Project Manager on client engagements, managing projects of varying size and complexity with limited supervision while meeting and exceeding performance expectations.

* Develops and maintains project management plans, including scope, work breakdown structure, schedule, milestones, deliverables, resource, communication, quality, and risk management plans, and applies standard methodologies, governance, tools, and templates to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery.

* Manages project schedule, budget, and resources, including forecasting, tracking actuals against plan, monitoring utilization, and supporting invoicing and financial reporting.

* Facilitates client discussions.

* Leads, mentors, and motivates project teams, setting clear expectations, monitoring performance, and fostering collaboration among client, subcontractor, and PCG staff.

* Identifies, tracks, and mitigates project risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions, and escalates to client and PCG leadership as appropriate.

* Leads project status meetings, steering committees, and stakeholder briefings, and prepares status reports, dashboards, and executive-level communications.

* Manages contract and scope compliance, including statement of work deliverables, change control, deliverable review and acceptance, and quality assurance.

* Participates in sales motions related to the practice, including developing project approaches, work plans, level-of-effort estimates, staffing plans, and pricing inputs for proposed engagements.

* Leads proposal writing teams, including writing sections, coordinating efforts, and preparing proposal submissions.
* Analyzes and interprets federal and state law and regulation.
* Prepares other written reports and materials for clients.

**Required skills**

* Ability to understand both the service delivery system for programs which are administered by states and monitored by federal regulators.
* Ability to understand and be an expert in complex federal regulations and requirements.
* Strong Microsoft Office applications skills
* Ability to use sound judgment in completing tasks and to seek guidance when needed.
* Attention to detail and ability to work with large data sets with accurate results.
* Ability to move projects forward within a specific timeline and budget while working at a detailed level.

* Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, scope, budget, risk, issue, and change management, using tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or Jira.

* Commitment to exceptional client service.
* Creative problem-solving ability and a consultancy mindset.
* Dedication to accomplishing goals and challenges presented by clients and management.
* Ability to interact with various levels of management and with clients.

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build trust with executive sponsors, align diverse stakeholders, and manage expectations.

* Flexible, self-starter possessing intellectual curiosity.
* Enthusiasm for life-long learning and staying well-informed about current business issues.
* Able to follow, critically evaluate, and improve upon current processes.
* Excellent business writing skills and ability to make presentations to various audiences.
* Ability to recognize issues and identify solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or 5 years’ experience required
* 5+ years of relevant work experience

* 3+ years of experience leading complex projects or workstreams, preferably in a state or federal government, health and human services, or technology implementation setting

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or comparable project management certification preferred
* **Must be located in the state of Hawaii, preferably on Oahu.**

**Supervisory Responsibility**

* Business Analysts

* Project team members, including consultants and project managers assigned to the engagement

**Working Conditions**

This position is hybrid with travel/onsite requirements. To be successful at PCG, you must:

* + be available during your set working hours
  + have a safe, private, and distraction-free environment in which to complete your work, and
  + be able to give your full attention to the completion of your PCG job duties

Some travel to the office or elsewhere may be required for team meetings, client meetings, etc. We are accepting applications on an ongoing basis until filled.

jobs.title: All-Source Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our government every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst, you’ll use your specialized functional experience and attention to detail to develop intelligence products to give your clients the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to support our warfighters.

  
  

As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst on our team, you’ll help your client by providing intelligence support to plans, operations, and exercises and illuminating threat trends and indicators through intelligence production and briefings. Using your comprehensive understanding of all-source intelligence analysis, cyberspace, IC tools, and databases, you’ll research, analyze, and evaluate classified reporting and produce finished intelligence and other data to assess the operational environment and meet CCMD and component organizations’ intelligence and information gaps. As an authority on your topic, your client will look to you for time-critical analysis, often under pressure. This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skill set in areas like research, analysis, and writing. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have the resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation’s leaders.

  
  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

  
  

**You Have:**

* 8+ years of experience in all-source intelligence analysis
* Experience writing finished intelligence products
* Experience applying all-source analytic tradecraft standards, including ICD 203 and 206
* Experience briefing senior military and government officials
* Experience collaborating with DoW or IC counterparts to produce finished intelligence
* Knowledge of Pacific regional security, strategic competition and influence activities, or adversary military capabilities and order of battle
* TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
* HS diploma or GED
  

  

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience as an all-source analyst supporting the PACOM AOR
* Experience supporting a Service Component Command, Combatant Command, Joint Task Force, or Intelligence Community organization
* Experience working with intelligence disciplines and associated data and tools, including HUMINT, SIGINT, GEOINT, OSINT, CYBINT, and partner reporting
* Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, including confidently interfacing with leadership
* Bachelor’s degree
  

  

**Clearance:**

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

jobs.title: Senior Continuous Improvement Program Manager - Oahu
jobs.description:
We recognize our competitive advantage - our people. We believe in our people, who share our vision of meeting the needs of our employees, customers, and communities and who carry out the continued success of the company.

  

Our employees are committed to the company's foundational values: integrity, excellence, teamwork, environmental stewardship, and community commitment. In turn, we invest in our employees, providing opportunities for challenge and advancement and offering a competitive compensation package.

  

Applications will be screened based on the information provided; in order to assist us in determining qualifications, please upload a current resume and take some time to update your employment information, certifications, etc. The information will flow over to your profile.

  

Posting End Date: This position will remain open until filled. Early applications are highly encouraged.

  

**BRIEF POSTING DESCRIPTION:**

The P ID TRAINING Department of the P GENERATION Division at Hawaiian Electric Company has 1 Management vacancy available. (Role: Professional)

  

**JOB FUNCTION:**

Leads and oversees the Continuous Improvement (CI) and operational excellence strategy for Generation Division, driving sustainable performance improvement, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation through Lean, advanced problem‑solving methodologies, and change management. Partners with senior leadership to prioritize and deliver high‑impact improvement initiatives and business solutions that achieve measurable results while overseeing CI projects. Acts as a principal change leader and subject matter expert by embedding continuous improvement practices into daily operations and leading complex initiatives aimed at improved business practices that meet regulatory and industry standards.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Owns and maintains the continuous improvement and operational excellence roadmap for the Power Supply Process Area, ensuring alignment with Generation and Company strategic objectives. Identifies and prioritizes improvement opportunities based on value, risk, performance gaps, and strategic impact. Establishes governance for continuous improvement initiatives, including performance metrics, benefit realization, and sustainability plans.
* Leads Continuous Improvement (CI) projects supporting Generation operations, including outage performance, asset reliability, safety, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support the execution of cybersecurity and risk management activities in accordance with DoD and federal standards. The ISSO will be responsible for implementing the DoDI 8510.01 Risk Management Framework (RMF), supporting Assessment and Authorization (A&A) processes, and ensuring the security posture of information systems.

**DESCRIPTION OF RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Execute the DoDI 8510.01 Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DoD Information Systems and assist in implementing DoD Assessment and Authorization (A&A) procedures.
* Manage and respond to security events and incidents, including triage, remediation, documentation, escalation, and after-action reporting.
* Participate in cybersecurity-related meetings such as Cyber Security Working Groups, system ATO discussions, and IT/Cyber status updates.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of comprehensive cybersecurity programs to protect organizational data, systems, and networks.
* Perform activities related to NIST RMF A&A processes and ensure compliance with policies governing classified and unclassified information systems.
* Ensure adherence to 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM), NIST SP 800-37, and DoDI 8510.01 standards.
* Provide mentorship and training to employees on cybersecurity concepts, policies, and best practices.
* Serve as a liaison with government points of contact (POCs) in a mid-level ISSO capacity.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

***Office conditions*** are varied and include physical tasks such as lifting, pushing or pulling up to 10 pounds. Physical positions will include, but not be limited to, walking, sitting or standing for extended periods of time, crawling, kneeling, stooping or cramped working places and work requiring repeated or frequent climbing.

***Environment*** will include customer contact, extended workdays, an office laboratory in a confined workspace.

**REQUIRED DEGREE/EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical discipline. [Relevant experience may substitute for a bachelor's degree]

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Eight (8) years of cybersecurity experience, with a strong background in information assurance and system security.
* Five (5) years of RMF experience.
  + Hands-on experience with DoD Authorization to Operate (ATO) compliance and certification processes.
  + Proficiency in creating and modifying RMF packages and artifacts throughout the acquisition lifecycle.
  + Ability to review and generate security documentation such as System Security Plans, POA&Ms, and Security CONOPs.
  + Experience preparing and implementing accreditation and certification requirements, including FISMA and COOP documentation.
  + Experience assisting Information System Owners (ISOs) with system registration, FISMA data calls, RMF documentation, and coordination with Certifying and Designated Approval Authorities.
* Experience with cybersecurity tools and platforms such as SIEM, ACAS, Trellix (ESS), eMASS, and STIGs.
* Ability to review threat and vulnerability assessments and analyze risks to information systems and networks.
* In-depth knowledge of current Government Information Assurance and Cybersecurity policies, regulations, and standards.
* Strong understanding of NIST SP 800-53 security and privacy controls and their application within RMF processes.

**REQUIRED SECURITY AND CLEARANCE:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen
* Secret security clearance is required. (Applicants selected either must currently possess a Secret clearance or will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements to obtain clearance prior to commencement of employment and maintain a security clearance for access to classified information or Closed/Restricted Areas throughout duration of employment.)

You will partner with clients to understand business needs, define project scope and success criteria, and coordinate the deployment, maintenance, and improvement of technology systems. * Manage IT infrastructure and SaaS application environments to ensure reliable operations, strong security controls, and effective backup and disaster recovery capabilities.

* Develop and implement operational processes and project management practices that improve efficiency, service delivery, and client experience. Gather client feedback and conduct post-implementation reviews to identify lessons learned and continuous improvement opportunities.

* Develop and maintain IT and cybersecurity policies, procedures, and standards for Global Impact clients.
* Ensure that all hardware and software assets are current, properly configured, and operate efficiently.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date IT and project documentation, including system configurations, project plans, status reports, decision logs, and procedures. Provide clear client-facing handoff materials that support adoption and ongoing service delivery.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Qualifying for this role means you have a bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, systems/network engineering, or a related field or equivalent combination of experience and education (multiple certifications in lieu of degree). jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
The Security Analyst is responsible for safeguarding the organization's IT infrastructure and data by owning daily operational security, privacy, and compliance workflows. This role focuses on executing day-to-day triage, coordinating evidence collection for multiple concurrent audits, and administering security awareness and privacy tasks to support the overall security posture of Windsor Fashions. The ideal candidate brings strong organizational and technical skills to manage first-line security events and maintain compliance timelines.

**Essential Job Functions & Responsibilities:**

* **Security Operations:** Perform first-line triage and investigation of Rapid7 and CrowdStrike alerts. Generate weekly vulnerability reporting, validate patches and updates, and monitor threat intelligence against Windsor’s environment.
* **Audit Support:** Coordinate internal evidence collection, manage compliance artifacts, and track remediation tasks across multiple concurrent assessments, including Grant Thornton (financial), AON (cybersecurity), Tevora (PCI-DSS Level 1), and the annual CCPA Cybersecurity Audit. Support the Manager as the internal engine driving the workflow behind external assessor engagements.
* **Privacy Operations:** Administer the OneTrust platform, manage Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) workflows, and drive cross-department follow-ups to ensure all statutory privacy timelines are met.
* **Third-Party Risk Management:** Perform first-pass vendor security reviews. Ingest and evaluate industry-standard vendor questionnaires—specifically the Standardized Information Gathering (SIG) questionnaire and the Consensus Assessments Initiative Questionnaire (CAIQ)—and track Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).
* **Awareness and Training:** Administer the security awareness training platform. Track user assignments for corporate and store employees, execute phishing simulations, and generate compliance reporting to meet audit requirements.
* **Policy Administration:** Manage the intake process for policy exceptions and risk-acceptance workflows. Schedule regular policy review cycles and ensure control-evidence documentation is kept up to date.
* **Tabletop and IR Support:** Provide logistical and administrative support for incident response readiness. Assist with scenario preparation, scheduling, and tracking after-action items to closure.

**Key Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in a security analyst or security operations role.
* Strong understanding of core security principles and operational best practices.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability management platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools.
* Knowledge of network and system administration within cloud and retail environments.
* Excellent problem-solving, project coordination, and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multi-department audit stakeholders.
* Certifications such as CompTIA's Security+ and CySA+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or AWS Certified Security - Specialty are a plus.

**Physical/Environmental Demands and** **Overtime & Availability:**

Ability to work overtime during peak seasons and as the business needs. Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards. Must have the ability to walk short distances. Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a small amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Adequate movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Team members are required to have close visual acuity to perform activities such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.
